Q5910.reason: A recorded common-plan promise not to build, expressly binding successors who take with notice, is enforced in equity as an equitable servitude; a general building ban is outside the historical negative easements.

Q5623.reason: The commentary is opinion about a public figure and a public protest, so the newsworthiness/public-interest privilege defeats an invasion-of-privacy claim; actual malice is neither shown nor a basis to prevail.

Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest can vest on a church use long after lives in being plus 21 years, and an age-25 gift to unborn children is also too remote, so the common-law RAP strikes it and the friend holds fee simple absolute.
